name: [Publik][Izin][AUTH-02] Repeated wrong-password logins get throttled
description: After many failed sign-ins for the same email the login page must slow down or lock out the attempt instead of accepting unlimited guesses.

planSteps.description: Sign in with email audit-throttle@example.com and password wrong-password-1
Repeat the same failed sign-in 11 more times, changing only the last digit of the password each time
Verify that after the repeated failures the login form shows a lockout or 'too many attempts' message with a wait time, not the same 'Email atau password tidak valid' message on every attempt

name: [Publik][Izin] Protected pages redirect an anonymous visitor to login
description: Cashier, sales report, and user management pages must not render for a visitor who is not signed in.

planSteps.description: Verify the browser ends on the /login page showing the sign-in form, and no sales table or rupiah totals are visible
